METZ.license: publisher supplementary data (Nature Chemical Biology), public mirror pinned
METZ.endpoint: pKi, single laboratory, single assay family
METZ.censoring: 50313 left-censored cells at 44 distinct thresholds; excluded
METZ.replicate_structure: none within panel (single measurement per cell)
METZ.verdict: supports the estimand structurally; CONSUMED as XP1/XP2 development panel

KLAEGER.license: publisher supplementary data (Science), public mirror pinned
KLAEGER.verdict: independent platform; 93.3% floor makes it a hit matrix, not a continuous crossed panel; already CONSUMED as XP1 cross-platform check and XP2-F external test

PDSP.endpoint: Ki (nM) from radioligand displacement; heterogeneous radioligands
PDSP.assay_comparability: radioligand is nearly a function of the target, so an assay-by-compound interaction is not separable from gamma
PDSP.verdict: continuous and replicated, but the assay confound is structural and the per-report noise is 0.714 log units; CONSUMED as XP1-C
